title: Waymo's latest expansion strategy: teenagers | TechCrunch
summary: Nashville is the second city to offer Waymo teen accounts; the company kicked off its teen account program in Phoenix last year. Waymo told TechCrunch that teen account holders can bring up to three guests ages 13 to 17.
